mapper.insert: insert into tb_board (user_email, board_title, board_content,board_likes,board_views) values (#{userEmail}, #{title}, #{content},#{boardLikes},#{boardViews})
mapper.select: select board_idx as boardIdx, board_likes as boardLikes, board_write_dt as boardWriteDate, board_title as title, board_content as content, from tb_board where user_email = #{userEmail}
